The '''Cron Drift''' was a giant [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field located within the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], near the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].

==Description==
The Drift was once was a small [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] of considerable beauty and dynamics; however, during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a Sith device used to manipulate matter within the cores of [[Star/Legends|stars]] caused [[Cron Supernova/Legends|the detonation]] of the nearby [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] stellar group, destroying nearby planets and forming the asteroid field. The Cron Drift held a reputation as a hiding place for all sorts of activity such as pirating, looting, and smuggling of illicit materials.

==History==
===Old Republic===
In [[3996 BBY]] [[Aleema Keto]] used [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] along with the ancient ship [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']] to destroy the nebula known at the time as the Cron Cluster, creating the Cron Drift. During the Cron Supernova, all planetary bodies in the vicinity were smashed, with the debris becoming scattered throughout the region. [[Dalos IV]], [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]], [[Kulthis]], [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], and [[Nespis VIII]] were closest to the explosion and affected by the detonation.

====Rise of the Empire====
Sometime before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]] was captured and imprisoned by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] in a tomb located within the Cron Drift. She was tormented by ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as a test before being retrieved by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] tried a [[clotheslegging]] scheme in the Cron Drift in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="HSatLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] communications [[Rebel base|outpost]] [[AX-235]] was located in the Cron Drift during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]]. During a [[Ambush in the Cron Drift|rendezvous]] between [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] [[Magnus (starship)|''Magnus'']], [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Ojai]]'', and [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Jeffrey]]'' delivering supplies and stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]]s to the outpost, an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|force]] consisting of four Imperial DX-9s escorted by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|assault gunboats]] attacked the outpost.<ref name="X-wing" /> The Imperials were defeated by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] piloted by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]], allowing the transfer to take place. The satellites later proved essential in discovering the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] project.<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A galaxy map depicting the various destinations of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency is seen in the queue of the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction at [[Disneyland Paris]] and [[Tokyo Disneyland]]. The map erroneously suggests [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] is in the Cron Drift, which is contradicted by many [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] sources.
